outcome: Plasma redox balance (TBARS, glutathione, nitric oxide levels)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women of advanced maternal age (patients) and 20 pregnant women younger than 40 years (controls).
finding: Pregnant women of advanced maternal age showed altered plasma redox balance (lower glutathione and NO, higher TBARS) and their plasma reduced hUMSC viability while increasing ROS and decreasing NO release.
